appName.description: Extension name. A brand name, keep it as is in every language.

appDescription.message: Hold Alt and hover any element to see its selectors, box model, styles, accessibility info and events without opening DevTools.
appDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and the store. Keep it under 132 characters. Alt is the key name, keep it.

appTagline.description: Short tagline under the name in the popup header.

settingsOpenLabel.description: Accessible label of the gear button that opens the settings panel.

settingsCloseLabel.description: Accessible label of the button that closes the settings panel.

infoOpenLabel.description: Accessible label and tooltip of the info button.

infoCloseLabel.description: Accessible label of the button that closes the info panel.

enabledToggleLabel.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the on/off switch in the popup header.

holdKeyLabel.description: Label of the select that picks the key to hold while hovering.

modifierAlt.description: Hold key option: the Alt key, called Option on Mac. Keep the key names.

modifierControl.description: Hold key option: the Control key. Keep the key name.

modifierShift.description: Hold key option: the Shift key. Keep the key name.

modifierMeta.description: Hold key option: the Command key on Mac, the Windows key elsewhere. Keep the key names.

holdKeyHint.message: Hold it and hover any element. Release to put the page back.
holdKeyHint.description: Hint under the hold key select.

whileHoldingLabel.description: Label above the grid of shortcuts that work while the key is held.

kbdClick.description: Shown in a key cap like a key name: a mouse click. Lower case, keep it short.

shortcutPin.description: Shortcut description next to the click key cap in the popup.

shortcutClose.description: Shortcut description next to the esc key cap in the popup.

shortcutParentChild.description: Shortcut description next to the up and down arrow key caps: move to the parent or child element.

shortcutSibling.description: Shortcut description next to the left and right arrow key caps: move to the previous or next sibling element.

shortcutCopySelector.description: Shortcut description next to the S key cap.

shortcutCopyXpath.description: Shortcut description next to the X key cap. XPath is a technology name.

shortcutCopyLocator.description: Shortcut description next to the L key cap. Playwright is a product name.

shortcutCopyHtml.description: Shortcut description next to the H key cap.

shortcutCopyText.description: Shortcut description next to the T key cap.

editorLabel.description: Label of the box that tells whether the current page can open sources in the code editor.

editorChecking.description: Text of the editor box while the page is being checked.

editorHint.message: Press <kbd class="kd-chip kd-font-mono">O</kbd> on an element with a source location to open it in your editor.
editorHint.description: Hint under the editor box. HTML: keep the <kbd> tag and the letter O inside it.

editorUnavailable.description: Editor box text when the page runs no dev server.

editorSources.description: Editor box text; SERVER is Vite or Next.js. Elements on the page know the file they were written in.

editorNoSources.message: $SERVER$ dev server, no element sources here
editorNoSources.description: Editor box text; SERVER is Vite or Next.js. The dev server runs but the elements carry no file locations.

settingsNote.message: Saved automatically and applied to open tabs immediately.
settingsNote.description: Note at the top of the settings panel.

settingAllowEditHint.message: Click values in a pinned panel to change styles, attributes and text on the page
settingAllowEditHint.description: Hint under the allow edits toggle.

settingsPopup.description: Settings section heading for what the popup itself shows.

settingEditorStatus.description: Toggle label: show the editor box in the popup.

settingEditorStatusHint.message: Whether this page can open sources in your editor
settingEditorStatusHint.description: Hint under the editor availability toggle.

settingsOverlay.description: Settings section heading for the highlight drawn on the page.

settingBoxModelHint.message: Margin, border, padding and gap bands
settingBoxModelHint.description: Hint under the box model highlight toggle. Margin, border, padding and gap are CSS terms.

settingsSections.description: Settings section heading above the toggles for each section of the panel.

sectionBox.description: Panel section title and its settings toggle: position, size and the box model.

settingBoxHint.message: Position, size, margin, padding, border, gap
settingBoxHint.description: Hint under the Box toggle. Margin, padding, border and gap are CSS terms.

sectionEvents.description: Panel section title and its settings toggle: event listeners.

settingEventsHint.message: Listeners, inline handlers and framework props

sectionStyles.description: Panel section title and its settings toggle: computed CSS styles.

sectionAccessibility.description: Panel section title and its settings toggle.

settingAccessibilityHint.description: Hint under the Accessibility toggle. ARIA is a technology name.

sectionAttributes.description: Panel section title and its settings toggle: HTML attributes.

sectionMedia.description: Panel section title and its settings toggle: images, video, audio, canvas and SVG.

settingMediaHint.message: Image, video, canvas and SVG details

sectionContext.description: Panel section title and its settings toggle: where the element sits and comes from.

settingContextHint.message: Source file, framework, ancestors and text

sectionSelectors.description: Panel section title and its settings toggle.

settingSelectorsHint.description: Hint under the Selectors toggle. CSS, XPath and Playwright are technology names.

infoIntro.message: QuickInspect shows what you need to know about any element without opening DevTools: selectors, the box model, computed styles, accessibility, attributes, events and the source file it came from.
infoIntro.description: Intro paragraph of the info panel. HTML: keep the seven <strong> tags. DevTools is the name of the browser developer tools.

infoStep1.message: Hold and hover any element to inspect it, release to put the page back. Pick a different key under Hold key on the main screen.
infoStep1.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep the empty <kbd> tag with its id, the extension fills it with the chosen key, and keep the <strong> tag. Use the same words as holdKeyLabel.

infoStep2.message: Click while holding to pin the panel, then drag its header to move it. Use ↑ ↓ for the parent or child and ← → for siblings.
infoStep2.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep the <strong> tag and the four <kbd> tags with their arrows.

infoStep3.message: Press <kbd class="kd-chip kd-font-mono">S</kbd> <kbd class="kd-chip kd-font-mono">X</kbd> <kbd class="kd-chip kd-font-mono">L</kbd> <kbd class="kd-chip kd-font-mono">H</kbd> <kbd class="kd-chip kd-font-mono">T</kbd> to copy the selector, XPath, Playwright locator, HTML or text.
infoStep3.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep the five <kbd> tags and the letters inside them, they are the keys to press.

infoStep4.message: In a pinned panel, click any value to edit styles, box, attributes or text. Enter applies, Esc cancels and reset undoes it all. Edits stay in the page until you reload.
infoStep4.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep the two <strong> tags and the two <kbd> tags with the key names Enter and Esc. Use the same word as panelReset for reset.

infoStep5.message: On a Vite or Next.js dev server, press O to open the element's source in your editor.
infoStep5.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep the two <strong> tags with the product names Vite and Next.js and the <kbd> tag with the letter O.

infoReport.description: Link in the info panel that opens the issue templates.

infoCreatedBy.description: Label before the author link in the info panel.

footerSections.description: Popup footer listing the panel sections. Must fit on one line of a 360px wide popup at a 10px font, so prefer short words. Keep the middle dots. Use the same words as the section titles.

panelPinned.description: Small upper-case tag in the panel header while the panel is pinned. Keep it short.

panelReset.description: Button in the panel header that undoes every edit made to the element. Lower case, keep it short.

panelResetTitle.message: Undo every edit on this element

panelCopy.description: Small button next to a selector that copies it. Lower case, keep it short.

panelOpen.description: Small button next to the source file that opens it in the editor. Lower case, keep it short.

panelRemoveAttribute.description: Tooltip of the × button that removes an attribute; NAME is the attribute name.

editValue.description: Accessible label of an edit field that has no other label.

boxHint.description: Hint next to the Box section title: the order of the four values in each box model cell. Keep this order.

boxEdgesPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the edit field for a box model cell; PROPERTY is the CSS property such as margin. Keep the order.

boxGapPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the edit field for the gap cell: the row gap, then the column gap. gap is the CSS property, keep it.

stylesHint.description: Hint next to the Styles section title: these are computed values.

shadowHostHint.description: Hint next to the Selectors section title when the element lives in a shadow root; HOST is the tag of the shadow host.

attributesMore_one.description: Hint next to the Attributes section title when more attributes exist than are shown, for a count of one; COUNT is the number of hidden attributes.

attributesMore_other.description: Hint next to the Attributes section title when more attributes exist than are shown; COUNT is the number of hidden attributes. Other plural forms may be added as attributesMore_few, attributesMore_many.

listeners_one.description: Hint next to the Events section title for a count of one; COUNT is the number of event listeners.

listeners_other.description: Hint next to the Events section title; COUNT is the number of event listeners. Other plural forms may be added as listeners_few, listeners_many.

children_one.description: Hint next to the Context section title for a count of one; COUNT is the number of child elements.

children_other.description: Hint next to the Context section title; COUNT is the number of child elements. Other plural forms may be added as children_few, children_many.

locatorMatches_one.description: Badge after a Playwright locator for a count of one; COUNT is how many elements it matches.

locatorMatches_other.description: Badge after a Playwright locator; COUNT is how many elements it matches. Other plural forms may be added as locatorMatches_few, locatorMatches_many.

locatorUnique.description: Badge after a Playwright locator that matches exactly one element.

noListeners.description: Text of the Events section when the element has no event listeners.

eventOriginInline.description: Badge on an event handler written as an HTML attribute such as onclick.

eventAnonymous.description: Name shown for an event listener function without a name.

rowPosition.description: Row label in the Box section: the x and y position on the page.

rowSize.description: Row label in the Box section: width and height.

rowRole.description: Row label in the Accessibility section: the ARIA role.

rowName.description: Row label in the Accessibility section: the accessible name.

rowFocusable.description: Row label in the Accessibility section: whether the element can receive keyboard focus.

rowSource.description: Row label in the Context section for the source file, and in the Media section for the media URL.

rowFramework.description: Row label in the Context section: the JavaScript framework that rendered the element.

rowComponent.description: Row label in the Context section: the framework component that owns the element.

rowText.description: Row label in the Context section: the text content of the element.

rowKind.description: Row label in the Media section: image, video, audio, canvas or svg.

rowNatural.description: Row label in the Media section: the natural (intrinsic) width and height of an image or video.

rowDuration.description: Row label in the Media section: the length of a video or audio.

rowAlt.description: Row label in the Media section: the alternative text of an image. Refers to the alt attribute.

strategyTestId.description: Row label of a Playwright locator that uses the test id attribute (getByTestId).

strategyRole.description: Row label of a Playwright locator that uses the ARIA role (getByRole).

strategyLabel.description: Row label of a Playwright locator that uses the form label (getByLabel).

strategyPlaceholder.description: Row label of a Playwright locator that uses the placeholder text (getByPlaceholder).

strategyAltText.description: Row label of a Playwright locator that uses the image alt text (getByAltText).

strategyTitle.description: Row label of a Playwright locator that uses the title attribute (getByTitle).

strategyText.description: Row label of a Playwright locator that uses the text content (getByText).

strategyCss.description: Row label of a Playwright locator that uses a CSS selector (locator). CSS is a technology name.

valueYes.description: Value of the Focusable row when the element can be focused.

valueNo.description: Value of the Focusable row when the element cannot be focused.

valueNone.description: Shown instead of a value when the element has no accessible name or a media element has no source.

valueEmpty.description: Shown instead of a value when the text or alt text is empty.

mediaLive.description: Duration shown for a live media stream that has no end.

addStyle.description: Button in a pinned panel that adds a new CSS style. Keep the leading plus sign.

addStylePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the field for a new style: a CSS property name, a colon, then its value.

addAttribute.description: Button in a pinned panel that adds a new HTML attribute. Keep the leading plus sign.

addAttributePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the field for a new attribute: the attribute name and its value in quotes. Keep the quotes and the equals sign.

kbdDrag.description: Shown in a key cap like a key name: dragging with the mouse. Lower case, keep it short.

kbdClickValue.description: Shown in a key cap like a key name: clicking a value in the panel. Lower case, keep it short.

footPin.description: Panel footer, next to the click key cap: a click pins the panel. Lower case, keep it short.

footUnpin.description: Panel footer, next to the click key cap while pinned: a click unpins the panel. Lower case, keep it short.

footMove.description: Panel footer, next to the drag key cap: dragging moves the panel. Lower case, keep it short.

footEdit.description: Panel footer, next to the click value key cap. Lower case, keep it short.

footClose.description: Panel footer, next to the esc key cap. Lower case, keep it short.

footParentChild.description: Panel footer, next to the up and down arrow key caps. Lower case, keep it short.

footSibling.description: Panel footer, next to the left and right arrow key caps. Lower case, keep it short.

footOpenSource.description: Panel footer, next to the O key cap: open the source file in the editor. Lower case, keep it short.

actionSelector.description: What the S key copies: the CSS selector. Lower case, used in the panel footer and in the toast "Copied selector".

actionXpath.description: What the X key copies. XPath is a technology name, used in the panel footer and in the toast "Copied XPath".

actionLocator.description: What the L key copies: the best Playwright locator. Lower case, used in the panel footer and in the toast "Copied locator".

actionHtml.description: What the H key copies: the outer HTML. Used in the panel footer and in the toast "Copied HTML".

actionText.description: What the T key copies: the text content. Lower case, used in the panel footer and in the toast "Copied text".

toastEditsReset.description: Toast after every edit on the element was undone.

toastNoSource.message: No source location for this element
toastNoSource.description: Toast when O is pressed on an element without a source file.

toastNoDevServer.message: No dev server to open the editor
toastNoDevServer.description: Toast when O is pressed on a page without a Vite or Next.js dev server.

toastOpened.description: Toast after the dev server opened the source file in the editor.

toastNotOpened.description: Toast when the dev server refused to open the source file.

toastNothingToCopy.description: Toast when a copy key found nothing to copy; WHAT is one of actionSelector, actionXpath, actionLocator, actionHtml, actionText.

toastCopied.description: Toast after a copy; WHAT is one of actionSelector, actionXpath, actionLocator, actionHtml, actionText.

toastCopyFailed.description: Toast when the clipboard write failed; WHAT is one of actionSelector, actionXpath, actionLocator, actionHtml, actionText.
